steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the base directories, configuration folders, metadata manifests, and app-meta resources for History 3D Explorer.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Settings
steps.description: Configure compile and target SDK 34, AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5 compatibility settings, and enforce Java 8 code optimization parameters.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Establish manifest schemas, configure portrait orientations, set launch themes, declare custom launcher references, and verify core namespaces.

steps.title: Design UI Core Layout
steps.description: Build XML declarations for activity_main, styling a fullscreen launch overlay, custom progressBar loaders, navigation text, and detail panels.

steps.title: Create History Data Model
steps.description: Develop HistoryEra.java to hold attributes, colors, detailed historical overviews, and structured trivia questions for educational quizzes.

steps.title: Implement Real-time Synth Audio
steps.description: Develop SoundSynthesizer.java with customized AudioTrack configurations, synthesising multi-tone chimes, sweeps, click ticks, and chord arpeggios on-the-fly.

steps.title: Build 3D Graphics Component
steps.description: Create History3DCarouselView.java utilizing standard Graphics Camera and Matrix transform functions to project historical elements onto 3D planes.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Swipe Gesture Engine
steps.description: Establish interactive drag behaviors, track pixel swipe movements, calculate scroll angles, and play audio ticks as elements shift.

steps.title: Implement 3D Depth Sorting Algorithms
steps.description: Write custom Painters Algorithm sorting filters inside the carousel to arrange rendering sequences based on Z-depth, preventing overlap bugs.

steps.title: Code Vector-Based Canvas Illustrations
steps.description: Develop detailed, scalable canvas geometry representations of the Pyramids, Parthenon, Roman Colosseum, Medieval Castles, and Rockets on cards.

steps.title: Implement Main Game Loops and Launch Timers
steps.description: Write activity loop procedures in MainActivity.java to update launcher text loaders, trigger startup chimes, and fade out loading screens.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic Educational Dialogue Trivia
steps.description: Write procedural builders for interactive pop-up trivia dialog sheets with correct/incorrect audio chimes and descriptive outcome answers.

steps.title: Building History 3D Explorer
steps.description: Run the Gradle system compiler to assemble the final release application and test the sound engine alongside the 3D graphics pipeline.
